workspace_intro: Every brand, one service platform. Native panels stay connected.
client_intro: Your site, requests and useful tools in one place.
preview_notice: Review preview with sample brands. No live requests or service changes. Connection checks are not simulated.
draft_intro: Working starters and experimental tools. New drafts enter human review before they join the library.
profile_note: This changes the service profile. Billing and ownership records stay separate. Client workspaces cannot be public showcases.
profile_error: Could not save. Check the profile and try again.
probe_error: Connection check could not finish. No successful connection was recorded.
queue_error: Could not queue the draft. Your brief is still here.
review_error: Review decision could not be saved.
setup_intro: The service could not load. It may need setup, or your session may have expired. Existing panels remain available.
no_workspaces: No workspace is assigned to this account.
commerce_desc: A crisp catalog, shop story and direct contact.
atelier_desc: Services, repair prices and appointment information.
food_desc: A considered menu, opening hours and location.
denim_desc: Calculate a hem reduction and prepare a fitting note. No pattern or cutting instructions.
choose_change: What would you like to change?
edit_intro: Tell us what you need. We prepare it and check it with you.
content_hint: Use your own words. For a photo, paste its link or describe what you want.
device_unavailable: Device saving is unavailable. Keep this page open.
not_published: Sending a request does not publish a change. Our team reviews it first.
received_note: Your request is in our queue. Keep the request number.
send_error: Could not confirm delivery. Your draft is safe. Try again; a repeated send will not create another request.
bad_link: This workspace could not be opened. Sign in or ask for a new link.
preview_edit_notice: Local review preview. Your draft stays on this device and cannot be submitted.
guided_intro: One decision at a time. Your preview updates as you work.
keep_content: Keeps your text and photos; updates the visual style.
invalid_measure: Enter two valid positive measurements. Desired length cannot exceed the current length.
denim_scope: For planning a fitting with your tailor. This is a measurement note, not a sewing pattern. Nothing is sent to a shop.
privacy_note: Do not enter customer names or contact details in this prototype.
validation_required: Please enter at least three characters.
copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the note and copy it manually.
unsupported_tool: This tool needs an individual implementation.
draft_too_long: The draft is too large for this worker.
publish_disabled: Publishing stays disabled in this review.
build_failed: Source review could not be created.
review_intro: Select a place on the preview and try the proposed text. The live site stays unchanged.
pick_target: Click a place on the preview
review_saved: Review saved. Publishing requires a separate decision.
preview_fetch_error: Site preview could not be loaded. Your request and notes are still available.
snapshot_notice: Read-only live snapshot. Red marks show the proposed content; inspect the prepared code before approving its release.
preview_only: Preview only; no decision was saved.
need_preview: Select the changed area and enter the proposed content before approval.
revision_note_required: Write a note explaining the revision.
preview_unlocated: Select the exact area. The request did not include a unique location.
release_note: Only the reviewed pull request version can be released.
release_queued: Release decision saved. The worker must confirm the reviewed version.
image_url_required: Enter a complete HTTPS image URL.
application_intro: New projects arrive here for human review. Status changes do not send email or create billing.
application_validation: Add your name, business name, and a valid email or phone number.
application_received: Your project is saved for review. Receipt
application_error: Could not save the project. Your draft is still on this device; retry or use email.
platform_review_intro: One service center. A clear place for every brand, request and draft.
platform_review_notice: These review screens use example content and do not change live services. Connection checks remain pending until configured.
human_release: Human review stays in the workflow. Approving content and authorizing a release are separate decisions.
draft_processing_error: The request was saved. Preparation failed; use Prepare queued drafts to retry.
visual_edit_note: Choose a named page area, change its text or photo, then compare the affected areas before sending.
edit_location_hint: For example: Home → Jean Maker → first button.
edit_location_required: Name the page and area so we can find your change.
